name: Castorcito sync
description: Sub-module of Castorcito that exports and imports Castorcito component configuration as a downloadable config tarball.
project_description: Castorcito sync is a sub-module of Castorcito that synchronizes component configuration through export and import. It provides an export form that packages selected (or all) castorcito_component and castorcito_category config entities — including container child components — into a config.tar.gz using core's export storage, a download route, and an import form that accepts a tarball and recreates the configuration entities on the target site. It depends on the core config module.
